instrument.verbatim_GRA_2024: Today, September 24, 2024, the Gambia Revenue Authority (GRA), led by its Commissioner General, Mr. Yankuba Darboe, participated in a sensitisation workshop on the African Continental Free Trade Agreement (AfCFTA). The event, hosted by the Ministry of Trade, Industry, Regional Integration, and Employment… focusing on the benefits and implementation of AfCFTA in The Gambia.
